description: Numerical modeling of lateral spread displacements at free-face sites using OpenSees is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Ellen Rathje, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). This data set contains files from numerical simulations of free-face lateral spread sites that were analyzed using OpenSees. The main goals of this study were to investigate the effects of site geometry, soil relative density, and earthquake shaking characteristics on lateral spreading displacements. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Lateral spreading, earthquake, liquefaction, displacement, OpenSees, finite element. Published 2021-01-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
